title: Fluent Rule Builders for All Laravel Validation Rules
content:
Laravel 13.36 adds Rule:: methods for required_with, accepted_if, url, uuid, distinct, and the other string-only validation rules, with IDE autocompletion.

The post Fluent Rule Builders for All Laravel Validation Rules appeared first on Laravel News.

author: Paul Redmond
